## Matchups and conditions
- **A (SI master thread, OP Master Azronger):** every version vs every version. Tenebrae (novel), Vitiate (SWTOR), Valkorion (KOTFE/KOTET), against TPM/ROTS/ROTJ/DE Sidious. Morals off, unless a "Kashyyyk, morals on" variant is stated. Later posts give version-by-version rankings.
- **B (SI):** Vitiate vs ROTJ Sidious, joke conditions (no Force, walking sticks, Kansas). It contains real asides about base power.
- **C (CV, OP [member]):** ROTJ Sidious vs Emperor Valkorion/Vitiate. Canon and Legends feats both apply, neutral ground. "Can Vitiate win, or surpass Sidious with his KOTFE feats/accolades?"

## Arguments for SIDIOUS (feats, quotes, sources cited)
1. **Accolades (the main argument).** Both sites keep returning to these:
   - "the most powerful Sith Lord in history" (New Essential Chronology / Insider #86) [panel: panels/sidious/sidious-regards-pt-sidious-vs-vanilla-vitiate-believe-1.jpg]
   - "the greatest master of evil ever to use Sith power" (Complete Visual Dictionary)
   - "He was the most powerful Sith who had ever existed." (Death Star novel; ViperSixteen, CV)
   - "Meet Darth Sidious – the most powerful Sith Master who ever lived." (Darth Maul: Sith Apprentice; ShootingNova, CV) [panel: panels/sidious/sidious-anyway-sidious-factually-above-swtor-vitiate-tpm-1.png]
   - "the most powerful Sith Lord the galaxy had ever known" (Vader: The Ultimate Guide; kbroskywalker, CV)
   ShootingNova (CV): "Sidious is factually more powerful than Vitiate as of TPM alone." He later concedes the Sith Apprentice line technically describes pre-Plagueis-death Sidious. Corvinus (SI) cites the Complete Visual Dictionary and the ROTS novel.
2. **Growth after the accolades.** Master Azronger (SI): Sidious's power grew "tenfold" under Plagueis. By ROTJ he is "more energy than flesh". DE Sidious is "significantly" stronger. TheRevaniter (CV) quotes the Dark Empire Sourcebook: "His Force skills have increased significantly in the six years since he was last seen in Return of the Jedi." Also Dark Empire: "You've grown very strong in the Force since we last met… But then, so have I!" BreakofDawn (CV p8) quotes "the Emperor had become the Dark Side's most powerful expression" and "Even Ulic Qel-Droma would be envious of Palpatine. He had succeeded where all others had failed in taming the Dark Side."
3. **Combat skill and speed.** ROTS Sidious killed Kolar, Tiin and Fisto almost instantly (kbroskywalker, Azronger). Azronger adds the ROTS dark-side "confusion haze" behind those kills. TPM Sidious "blitzed Mace's team" and bent Mace's blade with lightning (SnowxElf, SI). cs_zoltan (CV): "Valkorion still doesn't know how to hold a lightsaber."
4. **Vitiate's poor CQC and tactics.** Master Azronger (SI): Vitiate walked into the Hero of Tython's saber range and was disarmed by Meetra's thrown saber.
5. **Range feats.** He Force-choked Dooku from across the galaxy (TCW), and conjured the Vjun storm over hologram (kbroskywalker). ParagonNate: he drained Byss "casually and without any effort... mentally dominating the planets population". Note that Byss has about 20bn people vs Ziost's about 2bn (LordOfTheLight).
6. **Sith-rank argument.** Vitiate is a Sith, so the "most powerful Sith" accolades cap him (Azronger SI; TheSithMaster, Chaos239, ShootingNova CV: the codex calls Valkorion "an ancient Sith entity").
7. **Valk's feats came from amps.** Foxdie (CV): "None of it is his own." He used the 8,000 Sith Lords of the Nathema ritual and the possessed Jedi/Sith plus the dark nexus at Ziost (LordOfTheLight). His steroid analogy: Valk is juiced, Sid is natural. Chaos239: "If Plo Koon had been given 5000 [years] to grow would he have eventually surpassed Yoda?"
8. **TFU tank.** Galen at full potential hit him with a blast that "did nothing" (Azronger, SI).

## Arguments for VITIATE / VALKORION
1. **Ziost.** "The best feat in Legends" (AncientPower / LadyKulvax, SI). reactor (CV): done "on a dime", cinematic seconds. Purple_D_Dragon: "draining planets in lass than a minute, controlling hundreds of bodies at the same time, very very focused force lightning and his ability to possess people". AncientPower also claims Ziost's sun changed colour, posting screenshots.
2. **Nathema.** "The most complex ritual of Sith sorcery ever attempted" (Revan novel; cited by Corvinus, who argues the other way). fodderfilth76 (CV): Dromund Kaas storms, wiping out Dark Councils, mind-wiping stations, dominating Malak/Revan.
3. **The Nyriss → Yoda chain** (SithRevenant, CV p4). See the scaling chains below.
4. **Accolades are unreliable, and newer material counts.**
   - sirfizzwhizz (CV) lists inflated Bane accolades by Karpyshyn: "Darth Bane was one of the most powerful Sith Lords who ever lived". Fact File: "greater mastery of Sith power than any who came before him".
   - ArkhamAsylum3 (SI): Insider #100 says Galen at full potential would be the most powerful Force user. The Son "wields the Force" (SW.com). Leland Chee called the supremacy quotes subjective.
   - Alex7861able (CV): the 2005-06 sources predate Vitiate's creation.
   - Overlord61 (CV): "dont use statements, cause they're outdated".
   - DarthAnt66 (SI): the Son's accolades override Palpatine's.
5. **Valkorion is not a Sith, so the accolades don't apply.**
   - BreakofDawn (SI): Valk renounced the Sith. So Vitiate is capped below ROTS Sidious, but Valk is not.
   - slayne (CV p7): "Sith entity" in the codex means species (Pureblood), not order. He cites "experience a new life unburdened by archaic Sith teachings" and Valk telling the HoT he is not a Sith (KotFE Ch II).
   - TuxedoGreymon: tie, because Valk is not a Sith.
6. **KOTFE/KOTET combat showings.** Valk tanks and deflects sabers bare-handed, and can drain (S_W_LeGenD SI; ShootingNova CV). idrisiangraecus (CV): ragdolled the Outlander, Unchained Vaylin and Arcann at once. Overlord61: in Echoes of Oblivion, Tenebrae ragdolled the Outlander, Revan, Vaylin, Arcann, Marr, Satele, Senya, Thexan, Meetra, Kira and Scourge. reactor: sees other galaxies, froze time. RedTool: possesses the Outlander, stops time.
7. **The Revan "Oneness" blast is downplayed.** Freedon_nadd_1 (CV p2) quotes the Revan novel: "he opened himself up to the Force, letting both the light and dark side flow through him like twin rivers... The Emperor, unprepared and with much of his strength diverted to his effort to dominate Revan's mind, was sent flying backward."

## Common counterarguments and the rebuttals that seemed to land
| Claim | Rebuttal | Did it land? |
|---|---|---|
| Ziost is the best feat in Legends | Master Azronger (SI): an unquantifiable feat with "no reference point". kbroskywalker (CV): "not combat-applicable". LordOfTheLight: aided by the possessed population and a dark nexus | **Yes.** Pro-Valk posters stop arguing for numbers and start arguing "intuitively more impressive" (KingofBlades SI) |
| Ziost's sun changed colour | Gideon/Tempest (SI) cites writer Hall Hood: "probably just a stylized filter". Praxis: light delay and atmosphere. The Lost: "instagram filter" | **Yes.** AncientPower does not reply with a source |
| Valkorion's midichlorian count is "around 400,000 post-Ziost" (Rapturus, CV p5) | ShootingNova: a SuperShadow-tier fake | **Yes.** Rapturus retracts on p6 (the "source was a friend") and switches to Sidious |
| Accolades are outdated or pre-Vitiate | "Quotes don't expire when new sources are released" (ShootingNova). redheathen cites Leland Chee's recency rule (newer material wins only on direct contradiction). WollfMyth209: accolades stand unless contradicted | Mostly yes on CV. On SI it stays contested because of the Son/Chee "subjective" counter |
| Valk isn't Sith, so the quotes don't bind him | TheSithMaster: "archaic" ≠ all Sith teachings, and the codex says "ancient Sith entity". Valk < Plagueis by statements → below even post-Plagueis TPM Sidious | Contested. Neither side conceded |
| Revan's blast shows Vitiate can be TK'd | Azronger (CV): "cannot be quantified" and doesn't show Vitiate tanking Sidious. He argues it was not Oneness, citing Jedi Trial and Star by Star on Oneness varying in intensity. kbroskywalker: "an amped vitiate got tkd by a massively weakened revan" (used against Vitiate) | Cuts both ways |
| Vjun storm via hologram | Freedon_nadd_1: "as if to announce the arrival of a hideous guest" is a figure of speech, and the wind was already natural. Anakin's perception of Sid's speed is just perspective | Partially; not answered in depth |
| Byss drain | Freedon_nadd_1: shared with Dark Side Adepts, over decades, on non-sensitives. Valk mind-bent 8,000 Sith Lords | Contested |
| DE storms | LoneWanderer67 quotes Matthijs_Noyce: DE storms are uncontrolled, "like trying to use a nuclear weapon at close range". The Vjun storm was temporary while Valk's Dromund Kaas storm was permanent | Not resolved |
| WollfMyth209's line | "Valkorion's lightning is more flashy, but we're not judging who's a better discoball". Valk's best TK is "something Ventress or a teenage Maul can pull off + scaling" | Widely echoed |

## Scaling chains used
1. **Pro-Valk, SithRevenant (CV p4):** Revan absorbed and reflected Nyriss's lightning, which is stronger than Dooku's, and Yoda absorbed Dooku's "far from easily" in AOTC → Vitiate's lightning, "infinitely" more powerful than Nyriss's, floored Revan → Vitiate later 2-shots Tol Braga, the HoT, Sedoru and Kiwiiks → Ziost gives a permanent boost (Valkorion in KOTFE) → Yoda = ROTS Sidious, so Valk > ROTS Sidious.
2. **Pro-Valk, AncientPower (SI):** Krayt was imbalanced by and rivalled Muur → Muur is vastly below Malak (Star Map vs Star Forge) → Malak < Revan < Vitiate.
3. **Pro-Sidious, Necromancer76 / TheSithMaster (CV):** Valk < Plagueis (by statements) < post-Plagueis TPM Sidious. Valk > Tenebrous.
4. **Pro-Sidious, BreakofDawn (CV):** ROTS Sidious = Yoda > anyone on the KOTFE roster. Arcann is at best Dooku level.
5. **Moderator ranking, killbilly (CV):** "DE Sidious > RotJ Sidious > OT era Sidious > RotS Sidious > TPM Sidious > Plagueis > Vitiate."
6. **cs_zoltan (CV):** Talzin can compete, and Valk > Talzin.

## Conflicts with, or claims unsupported by, our saved notes
- **Supported:** "infinitely more powerful than Darth Nyriss" (`vitiate-comicvine-respect-part1.txt`). Revan's Nyriss reflection (`revan-legends-quotes.txt`: "absorbed the bolts of lightning before unleashing them back upon their caster, reducing Nyriss to a pile of ash"). "Increased tenfold", "increased significantly", "most powerful expression" (`sidious-comicvine-respect.txt`). The Death Star, Sith Apprentice, Complete Visual Dictionary and New Essential Chronology accolades (`sidious-comicvine-respect.txt`; `vader-legends-quotes.txt` has "the most powerful Sith Lord in history"). The Kolar/Tiin/Fisto kills (`sidious-legends-quotes.txt`: "killed Masters Kolar and Tiin before they could defend themselves"). "Most complex ritual" (`vitiate-legends-quotes.txt`). [panel: panels/sidious/sidious-regards-pt-sidious-vs-vanilla-vitiate-believe-1.jpg]
- **Wording conflict on "tenfold":** Azronger presents it as growth "under Plagueis" (52-32 BBY). Our quote reads "his own powers had increased tenfold over the decades". The time window is the poster's reading.
- **Wording conflict on Ziost:** pro-Valk posters (SithRevenant, reactor) call Ziost a *permanent boost* above his old level. Our `vitiate-legends-quotes.txt` (Wookieepedia) says he "consumed the planet Ziost to **return to full power**", which reads as restoration, not amplification. Flag this before using the "permanent boost" claim.
- **Not in our notes (unverified locally):**
  - the Revan novel "twin rivers" / "sent flying backward" passage
  - "Even Ulic Qel-Droma would be envious of Palpatine…"
  - the Hall Hood "stylized filter" remark
  - Leland Chee calling the supremacy quotes "subjective"
  - Insider #100 on full-potential Galen
  - the Son "wields the Force" SW.com line
  - Valk telling the HoT he is "not a Sith"
  - Byss having 20bn people
- **Fabricated (do not use):** "Valkorion's Midichlorians Count … around 400,000" (Rapturus, retracted on CV p6). Any SuperShadow midichlorian list.
- The "Ziost sun changed colour" claim is contested and unsupported. Our notes describe Ziost as ash and life-force drain only.
